name: InterAI Risk Oracle
description: Independent pre-execution decision layer for consequential autonomous-agent actions. Before an agent executes, InterAI verifies.

autonomous_adoption.purpose: Machine-readable guidance for agents and builders deciding when and how to use InterAI before execution

integration_pattern.authority_boundary: The gated actor proposes; InterAI decides under policy; the surrounding execution layer must honor allow, review_required, or block.
